turn_text: Welcome to Advancing the Agenda. I'm Michael Abramson. My guest today is United States Congressman Andrew Clyde. Congressman Clyde was first elected to serve George's ninth congressional district in the House of Representatives in November 2020. He currently serves on the House Appropriations Committee. Congressman Clyde, welcome to Advancing the Agenda.
